low_light.instruction: Lift exposure in underexposed regions and improve midtone visibility so existing structures and textures are easier to see. Retain tonal separation around existing bright light sources.

denoise.instruction: Reduce visible luminance noise and colored speckles while retaining source-supported edges and natural surface texture.

deblur.instruction: Reduce motion or defocus blur that impairs the target content, improving source-supported edge definition and natural edge transitions. Retain intentional depth-of-field blur outside the target.

dehaze.instruction: Reduce the obscuring haze veil and improve visibility and local contrast in the affected regions. Retain natural depth-dependent atmospheric perspective and plausible lighting colors.

derain.instruction: Remove visible rain streaks that obscure the scene while preserving object boundaries, wet-surface reflections and the existing lighting.

desnow.instruction: Remove falling snowflakes that obscure scene content while retaining snow already lying on surfaces and the original weather illumination.

deblock.instruction: Reduce JPEG block boundaries, ringing and mosquito artifacts while keeping real contours and source-supported texture.

super_resolution.instruction: Improve source-supported fine detail and edge definition at the externally configured output resolution, preserving the field of view and original composition.

color_cast.instruction: Correct the unwanted color cast on intended neutral surfaces while preserving meaningful colored illumination and natural relative object colors.

highlight_recovery.instruction: Reduce excessive brightness in the targeted highlights and improve tonal separation where image signal remains. Keep fully clipped regions smooth rather than inventing missing scene details.
